extraction.notes: Starting line taken from the FFO reconciliation (net loss available to common shareholders of $(10,196)), not the Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation which shows $(8,589). FFO total 18,526 and Core FFO 17,922 tie to the printed subtotals. Diluted FFO per share: 18,686 / 18,542 = $1.01; diluted Core FFO: 18,082 / 18,542 = $0.98, both consistent. Company reports no AFFO metric. Core FFO diluted (18,082) adds back preferred unit dividends of 160 to the common Core FFO of 17,922; the share count 18,542 is the diluted count used for per-share figures. 'Technology implementation costs' has no matching category and was coded as 'other'. Capex table shows same-store total capital expenditures per apartment home of $145 for the quarter, a per-unit figure only; no company-level quarterly total was found, so recurring capex is left null. Zero-amount lines (—) are included as printed.
